owner_and_capability: Scheduler Runtime (services/scheduler) declares its own ports onto Student Presence (session end, abandoned sessions, nightly presence cleanup), Care Plan (end-of-day status flag archive) and the Delivery Platform (standalone usage sweep, overdue live events); the root composition (api/scheduler_presence_ports.go) binds them; the Delivery Platform's realtime package builds the overdue event envelopes. Step 2 of #4067 (ADR 0056 point 4, ADR 0058 point 2).

atomic_cutover: One PR, no policy change. services/scheduler/presence_ports.go declares SessionMaintenance (DailySessionsEnded), PresenceCleanup (ExpiredVisitCleanup, StaleSupervisorCleanup, StaleAttendanceCleanup), StudentStatusFlagArchiver.ArchiveEndOfDayStatusFlag, PWAUsageCleanup and InstanceOverdueBroadcaster; the Worker's fields and WorkerDependencies take them. api/scheduler_presence_ports.go binds Student Presence's services, Care Plan's archive (sick flag as sick day, excused flag as excused day, end-of-day source), Delivery's usage sweep and the realtime hub (tenant-wide realtime.NewInstanceOverdueEvent and NewInstanceOverdueRefreshEvent). realtimeevents.PublishInstanceOverdue and PublishInstanceOverdueRefresh, whose only caller was the Worker, move into realtime as event constructors; their tests move with them. Seven keys fall (512 -> 505); statuses, sources, events, results and log fields are unchanged.
